title: Implement drag, move, and resize for canvas elements
description: Implement the ability to drag, move, and resize tables and relationship elements on the diagram canvas for better organization.
acceptanceCriteria: User can drag tables to reposition on canvas
Canvas updates accordingly when elements are moved or resized
